description:
[read-only] Sign-ups, first posts and paid conversions per sign-up source (paid:<network>, organic, outreach, friends_family, internal, unknown), with the total net of friends/outreach/internal, and per ad campaign, ad content, ad set (utm_term) and landing path, including the campaign x landing grid (optional campaign prefix filter, e.g. fl-w1-). Counts only, no identities. Every brand except the owner brand gets 403.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/analytics/signup-sources.)

campaign.description: Keep only campaigns whose utm_campaign starts with this (e.g. fl-w1-). Filters `campaigns` only.

name: get_signup_sources
title: Sign-ups by source (owner brand only)
